our_interpretation: Plain reading: LeCun's world-model approach (JEPA, pursued at AMI Labs) will not fix many known LLM problems, such as hallucination, unreliable reasoning or poor generalization.
No deadline was stated, so this is an open-horizon forecast.
The forecast would be contradicted if JEPA-based systems were shown, in public evaluations, to largely fix several of these problems.
